title: Performance Evaluation of the JAXA’s New Supercomputer System: SORA-MA
version: JAXA-SP-15-013, pp. 53–57, proceedings of the July 2015 symposium

passages.note: The JAXA operator describes FX100 system-level inheritance from FX1, K and FX10, and verifies the deployed six-dimensional Tofu2 mesh/torus and the integrated network controller. It compares UPACS-Lite performance on FX1, FX10 and FX100; the benchmark measures the application and varies platform and tuning.
